title: Attacks in Mall World..?
content: I noticed a post or 2 that were saying there is a Problem with being attacked while in that Dream Space/Realm.. Consider looking at your Own patterns while Awake in This realm. What Programs make you feel Attacked? What are you Taking In while Awake in This Realm? Consider that it is your own Ego attempting to Protect you from stumbling upon a Truth that it Feels is Scary.. Consider Weeding out things that Make you feel Attacked. Examine those things that Trigger this Feeling while Awake in This Realm. Shed these Programs & Shift your Perception to the Possibility that these things that Make you Feel this way are a Kind of Manipulation to Keep you in what I call The Divided Mind. What's Making you feel Separate for the Whole, in the Us vs. Them Mentality. Write each one down. The act of Naming these is the first step to Facing these Shadows. Be Radically Honest with yourself, Even If it Hurts. After this facing your Shadows, these Programs begin to Fall Away, no longer having the Same Effect. Bring you Detachment from Reactive Emotional Behavior. Also bringing Discernment & a bit of Clarity to Spot these Triggers. Then you can just let these Feelings Move Through you instead of Holding them Within you. Find that these Feelings Aren't Yours, they are Just Past Programs that you Set aside as No Longer Serving you. This may Sound Difficult, but, Radical Honesty actually Lessens it. Trust yourself to Be this Honest with yourself. Know that you are Loved Unconditionally. Be Blessed.
